identity.baseline: monaco-editor-core@0.56.0 final editor.main.js closure on Google Chrome 151.0.7922.109

sourceEffectClosure.reachabilityAlgorithm: Parse ECMAScript modules, recursively resolve relative static import and export-from edges from editor.main.js within esm/vs, and classify non-JavaScript side-effect imports separately.
sourceEffectClosure.requiredGeneratedAudit: MonaEnvironmentManifest.json enumerates every matched source occurrence, its pinned source hash, native symbol, disposition and acceptance fixture; a count-only manifest fails C10.

qualifiedRuntimeObservation.rule: These fields qualify the current machine only and are recollected for every acceptance run; they contain no serial number, UUID, UDID or persistent display identifier.

languageAndLocaleSeparation.uiLanguage: N1-R owns UI messages. MonaCodeEnvironment selects one immutable N1 profile before first access; the default profile is en and no system-locale mapping occurs implicitly.
languageAndLocaleSeparation.runtimeLocale: MonaRuntimeLocale is a separate immutable process-start snapshot used only where the fixed source asks JavaScript or Intl for the default runtime locale. On the current qualified run it is zh-CN.
languageAndLocaleSeparation.unicodeHighlighter: The _vscode locale is the selected N1 UI profile and the _os locale is MonaRuntimeLocale. They never alias unless their explicit values are equal.
languageAndLocaleSeparation.snippetNames: CURRENT_DAY_NAME, CURRENT_DAY_NAME_SHORT, CURRENT_MONTH_NAME and CURRENT_MONTH_NAME_SHORT remain N1 localized message identities; the fixed core default profile emits English names even when the runtime locale is zh-CN.

textSemantics.representation: All operations accept and return raw UTF-16. Valid scalar subsequences are transformed according to the pinned tables; isolated high and low surrogates are copied unchanged; no implicit normalization occurs.
textSemantics.defaultCaseConversion: Repository-owned Swift algorithms implement the Chrome 151 observable ECMA-262 default upper/lower conversion over the pinned Unicode data.
textSemantics.localeCaseConversion: Repository-owned Swift algorithms implement the Chrome 151 observable ECMA-402 locale-sensitive conversion using MonaRuntimeLocale and generated immutable Chromium-ICU data. Foundation case conversion is not a semantic oracle.

caseActionFamilies.rule: Each family ports its own pinned source algorithm; equal names do not authorize sharing a different algorithm.

collationProfiles.tieBreak: When collation returns zero and strings differ, raw JavaScript relational ordering breaks the tie.

textSemantics.collationData: Generated immutable tables are derived from the exact Chrome 151 Chromium-ICU commit and local icudtl.dat hash for every locale supported by that baseline. The current release gate qualifies zh-CN; the product table set is not reduced to zh-CN.

normalization.fastPath: Empty strings and strings containing only U+0000 through U+0080 return without normalization.
normalization.nfcCache: Baseline-inert allocation; absent in native code.
normalization.tryNormalizeToBase: Apply NFD, remove only U+0300 through U+036F, accept the deaccented value only when raw UTF-16 length is unchanged, then apply locale-insensitive lowercase.

inactiveIntl.segmenter: The only retained word-segmenter activation requires wordSegmenterLocales, which is an explicit F1 member cut; the other consumer is WebGPU and is cut. No Intl.Segmenter runtime ships.
inactiveIntl.locale: Intl.Locale is reachable only through the cut wordSegmenterLocales validation path and ships no runtime replacement.
inactiveIntl.numberFormat: The active Unicode-highlighter call only resolves the default OS locale and is replaced by MonaRuntimeLocale; no number formatting runtime ships.

entropy.architecture: MonaRandomDoubleSource and MonaCryptoRandomSource are process-global MainActor dependencies. Production sources use system entropy; conformance runs inject exact values and record every draw.
entropy.mathRandomDomain: Each production draw returns one binary64 value x with 0 <= x < 1. The product does not promise the same seed or sequence as V8.
entropy.numberToString: A repository-owned ECMA-262 Number::toString implementation for radix 10 and 16 produces the raw source string; snippet RANDOM and RANDOM_HEX then take the final six UTF-16 code units exactly as the pinned source does.
activeDrawOrder: snippet RANDOM and RANDOM_HEX variable traversal
suggest-controller telemetry sampling draw even though S1 telemetry output is a no-op
suggest-model telemetry sampling draw even though S1 telemetry output is a no-op
entropy.baselineInertDraw: onClickAnimation has no registration in the fixed standalone graph, so its three Math.random calls never execute.
entropy.uuid: Use system cryptographic random bytes, force RFC 4122 version-4 and variant bits, and emit the canonical lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 form. Conformance injects all 16 bytes.

clocksAndScheduling.wallClock: Date.now maps to an injected signed integer Unix-epoch millisecond wall clock. Production uses CLOCK_REALTIME semantics already fixed by M1-R3; it is never replaced by a monotonic clock.
clocksAndScheduling.dateObject: new Date maps to a value created from the same injected wall clock. Snippet calendar fields use the Gregorian calendar and the resolver's captured system time-zone snapshot.
clocksAndScheduling.highResolutionClock: MonaHighResolutionClock uses mach_absolute_time and the Mach timebase, matching Chromium 151 TimeTicks on macOS. It is injected for conformance, increases monotonically while the machine is awake, and never substitutes for Date.now.
clocksAndScheduling.stopWatch: The fixed graph has 21 StopWatch construction sites: 13 retained sites use MonaHighResolutionClock, six retained sites pass false and use the wall clock, and two high-resolution Tree-sitter sites are cut. Elapsed values retain their source roles in debounce adaptation, timeout decisions, diagnostics and measurement records.
clocksAndScheduling.inputLatency: The retained input-latency recorder implements eight marks, four measures, one duration read, eight mark clears and four measure clears over MonaHighResolutionClock; keydown, beforeinput, input, render, keyup and selection-change ordering is retained.
clocksAndScheduling.directPerformanceNow: The four direct performance.now calls belong to the cut Tree-sitter path and have no native implementation.
clocksAndScheduling.microtasks: All eleven queueMicrotask sites use the repository MainActor microtask queue and preserve FIFO order after the current synchronous stack.
clocksAndScheduling.timers: All retained setTimeout, clearTimeout, setInterval and clearInterval sites use one cancellable MainActor scheduler with the exact source delay and source reschedule rule; deterministic fixtures inject the clock and drain order.
clocksAndScheduling.animationFrames: V1-R4 owns display-frame scheduling, priority order and cancellation. Native callbacks use the qualified display's actual cadence and the same immutable view generation gate.
clocksAndScheduling.idleWork: Code-editor contribution construction and CodeLens old-key removal use a cancellable low-priority MainActor idle queue. Fixtures inject idle grants and assert source order; editor disposal cancels outstanding work.
clocksAndScheduling.timeoutRule: A source timeout that reads Date.now observes wall-clock jumps exactly through the injected wall clock; no hidden monotonic substitution is permitted.

matchMedia: backing-scale changes map to V1/I3 native window and screen events
forced-colors maps to T1/A2 native accessibility contrast state
reduced-motion and reduced-transparency map to A2 native accessibility state
browser display-mode has no retained native consumer
systemEnvironmentMappings.domObservers: ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver and MutationObserver effects map to explicit NSView geometry, visibility, content and window event sources; no DOM observer implementation ships.
systemEnvironmentMappings.remoteAuthorities: The fixed graph sets only a preferred web schema and never registers authority host, port or delegate values. MonaURI retains the logical vscode-remote identity and H1 opener routing; MonaCode performs no rewrite, fetch or network connection.
forbiddenImplicitSideEffects: locale or time-zone change observers that mutate an initialized runtime snapshot

productionDependencyRule.allowed: Generated immutable Unicode, normalization, case and collation tables with recorded Unicode and Chromium-ICU provenance and notices.
productionDependencyRule.forbidden: Bundled or dynamically linked ICU code/runtime, JavaScriptCore, V8, WebView, NSRegularExpression as semantic substitution, and Foundation case/collation/normalization output as unverified truth.
productionDependencyRule.distribution: MonaDistributionManifest records every generated table hash, generator revision, exact inputs, transformation recipe and the Unicode plus ICU license notices.

acceptance.C02: Raw-UTF16 case, locale-case, normalization, collation and Number::toString fixtures match fixed Chrome 151 under injected runtime locale, time zone, wall clock and entropy traces.
acceptance.C04: MonaEnvironmentManifest classifies every environment-sensitive occurrence in the exact 956-JavaScript plus 98-style-resource closure and exposes no extra public host setting.
acceptance.C05: All seven line-action transforms, seven snippet transforms, four Collator constructions, eleven localeCompare call sites, 21 StopWatch construction sites and input-latency traces match.
acceptance.C06: Provider, command, snippet, suggestion and Unicode-highlighter paths retain raw UTF-16, default-locale separation and draw/order behavior.
acceptance.C09: The two active normalization LRUs each cap at 10000, all timers/idle/frame callbacks cancel on owner disposal, and no runtime locale or generated table leaks per editor.
acceptance.C10: Linked binary and resource scans prove no ICU runtime/code or JavaScript engine and verify all generated data hashes, provenance, notices and occurrence dispositions.
acceptance.P08: Search and transform workloads include locale/default case, NFD/base normalization and injected clock/entropy vectors without changing preregistered workload IDs.
acceptance.P11: Provider and UI-present workloads include collation, sort stability, snippet date/random, suggestion sampling draws, wall-versus-high-resolution StopWatch roles and input-latency traces against both baselines.
acceptance.oracleRule: Chrome 151 is the exact semantic oracle. ECMA-262, ECMA-402, Unicode 17 and Chromium-ICU sources define the clean-room implementation inputs; a disagreement with the fixed Chrome output fails the case.
